meta.title: Schub — game server hosting and control
meta.description: Schub hosts game servers, starts them on demand, and equips a League of Legends team: roster, statistics, champion pool and draft preparation.

hero.title: Game servers that switch on when you need them
hero.subtitle: And, for League of Legends, what it takes to run a team.

about.title: What Schub does
about.servers: Game servers are hosted at home and driven from the site or from Discord: their state is visible live, and starting or stopping one is a button. Port forwarding opens and closes along with the server.
about.lol: On the League of Legends side, Schub reads your games through Riot's API: personal and team statistics, champion pool by role, draft preparation and post-game review.
about.identity: Identity goes through Discord. There is no password to remember, and rights follow your role.

onboarding.title: To get up and running
onboarding.intro: What is left to do on your profile. Every line leads there.

onboarding.signedOutBody: Server status is public, but starting a server, linking your League of Legends account and joining a team all need a Discord account.
